description: This PHP source file defines the NullCoalesceExpression class, part of the Twig templating engine, handling null coalescing expressions within Twig templates. It extends ConditionalExpression and manages deprecated usage patterns, constructs tests for null and defined values, and compiles PHP code for null coalescing operations.

classes.name: NullCoalesceExpression
classes.description: Represents a null coalescing expression node in Twig's internal abstract syntax tree, handling the parsing and compilation of ?? expressions within Twig templates.

methods.description: Initializes the expression node, performs deprecation warnings, constructs a test node combining 'defined' and 'null' checks, and ensures correct node setup.
